description: Full Racket Check of a local service provider's website URL. Fetches the homepage plus the pricing, services, plans and terms pages it links to (same host, capped) and scores racket signals: subscription / plan / membership language, minimum-visit or package requirements, contract lock-in language (term agreements, termination fees, auto-renew), and pricing transparency — exact prices published vs call-for-quote only. Returns machine-readable JSON LED BY THE VERDICT — CLEAN / PLAN_PUSH / RACKET / UNKNOWN — plus a plain-language verdict line and a 0-100 score (100 = cleanest one-time provider), per-signal found/severity with evidence snippets from the site's own pages, the pages checked, and a pricing block (exact prices found, samples, call-for-quote-only flag). FAIL-CLOSED: if the site cannot be fetched or no readable service content comes back, the verdict is UNKNOWN with score null — never CLEAN on missing data. HONEST LIMITS: reads the public website only; it cannot see quotes given by phone or in person, and a site that hides its plan terms behind a login will read thinner than it is. Cost: $1.00 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402 — the caller's agent pays from its owner's approved wallet; no API key needed. Use this before booking any local service provider — lawn, cleaning, HVAC, pest control, and similar — to catch a subscription or minimum-visit push before it starts.

url.description: Service provider website URL to check for racket signals, e.g. https://example-lawncare.com

name: racket_check
